subject: Television & Streaming
title: Ed Sullivan's Cultural Stage
description: A micro-lesson that makes Ed Sullivan's Cultural Stage usable.

hook.text: Ed Sullivan couldn't sing, dance, or tell jokes. He hosted the most important show in television history.

buildup.text: His show ran for 23 years. He booked anyone America needed to see—from opera singers to rock bands.

discovery.text: When Sullivan booked Elvis Presley in 1956, 60 million people watched. It was the largest TV audience ever.

twist.text: Sullivan faced constant pressure to censor acts. He told the Rolling Stones to change their lyrics on air.

climax.text: His stage became America's gatekeeper. If you played Sullivan, you existed. If not, you didn't.

punchline.text: The man with no talent decided who had it.

quiz.question: How many viewers watched Elvis Presley's appearance on The Ed Sullivan Show?
